Product Description

Immerse yourself in the ambiance of a warm fire with the iconic Fireside fragrance from WoodWick. This large Hourglass candle, crafted in the USA, combines the finest ingredients including notes of bergamot, amber, exotic woods, and musk to create a sophisticated, complex scent. The patented Pluswick Innovation wick offers a unique sensory experience with its distinctive crackling sound and intriguing glow. The blend of paraffin and soy wax ensures an even, clean burn, filling your home with a rich, nuanced aroma. This high-quality candle also makes a coveted gift for a friend or loved one.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
There’s a reason why this isn’t my first WoodWick..
First woodwick I had was the Woodwick Vanilla Bean oblong candle. It almost looked like a mini fireplace, I loved it! Problem is - it’s too expensive to replace it. So I settled for the WoodWick Hourglass in Fireside - sure enough, I didn’t settle for less! If you’ve ever just melted and caramelized sugar in a sauce pan - that’s what this particular candle smells like! Just has a touch of sweet, woodsy scent along with it. Love how the lid of the candle doubles as a base to protect your surfaces! When you light it for the first time, the flame will appear offset but just give it a chance to do its job. The flame engulfs the wood wick and immediately starts crackling - just like a fireplace on a small scale! The flame is bright enough to light up a small room for a romantic or soothing environment. Very therapeutic. Like any candle, you have to maintain them. Make sure to carefully read the label on the bottom of the jar before you light it so you know what to do. Please don’t flip it while it’s lit and be careful when blowing it out as the wax on these candles are much less viscous than other candles. I don’t recommend using this candle for longer than 3 1/2 to 4 hours cause the wax liquefies quickly on the second or third use. This candle is totally worth every bit of the $18 I paid for it and I look forward to buying my next one from here! Shipped quickly, got here the next day.

    This WoodWick Fireside candle is exactly what I was hoping for. The scent is warm and cozy, like a real fireplace burning on a cold evening. It’s not too sweet or overpowering, which I really appreciate. It makes the room feel comfortable and relaxing without giving me a headache.

    The wooden wick is my favorite part. It actually crackles while it burns, and the sound is surprisingly calming. It really does feel like having a small fire going, especially at night. The candle burns evenly, and the scent throw is strong enough to fill a living room without being overwhelming.

    I also like the size and look of the jar. The 9.7 oz hourglass glass looks nice on a table or shelf, and it makes a great gift for both men and women. I’ve already used it during the holidays, but I can see myself burning this all winter long.

    If you’re looking for a quality fireside candle, a relaxing wooden wick candle, or a holiday candle gift that actually smells good, this one is a solid choice. I would definitely buy it again and try other WoodWick scents.

    The Woodwick Ellipse Scented Candle in Fireside brings a unique sensory experience to any room, combining the comforting sound of a crackling fire with the warm, inviting aroma of a cozy evening by the hearth. Housed in a 16oz ellipse-shaped vessel, this candle not only serves as a source of light and fragrance but also as a decorative piece that enhances the ambiance of your living space.

    Design and Usability

    The design of the Woodwick Ellipse Candle is both elegant and practical. The distinctive oval shape allows for a wider opening, ensuring a more consistent fragrance throw and an even burn. The natural wooden wick is the centerpiece of this candle, designed to mimic the sound of a crackling fire, creating a soothing, immersive experience. Lighting the candle is straightforward, and the wick's performance is reliable, offering a clean burn without excessive soot.

    Fragrance and Performance

    Fireside is a fragrance that captures the essence of a perfect evening by a wood fire. It combines the scents of amber, vetiver, and musk to produce a rich, smoky aroma that fills the room with warmth and comfort. The fragrance is both nostalgic and sophisticated, making it ideal for colder months or any time you wish to add a touch of coziness to your surroundings. The candle's 16oz size promises a long-lasting burn time, offering hours of enjoyment and making it a great value for those who cherish atmospheric lighting and aroma in their homes.

    Conclusion

    The Woodwick Ellipse Scented Candle in Fireside is a remarkable product that stands out for its innovative design, exceptional fragrance, and the unique auditory experience it provides. It's more than just a candle; it's an invitation to enjoy the simple pleasures of life, like the warm glow of firelight and the comforting crackle of burning wood. Whether you're looking to create a cozy atmosphere for relaxation or seeking a thoughtful gift, this candle is sure to delight.

    Beautiful scent....Purchased 2 more.
    Reviewed in the United States on July 10, 2025
    Color: FiresideSize: 21.5oz
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Purchased this candle on Prime Day. One of my favorite scents is Yankee's Pink Sands. It's great for the summer, but it is a sweet scent. I wanted something very different to change it up. The description for this candle (Fireside) says: bergamot, amber, exotic woods, and musk. Like others who've left reviews, I STRUGGLE to try to describe the smell. It is definitely NOT anything sweet, but it IS a DEEP, warm, luscious, cozy, homey smell. Not sure it SMELLS anything like a fire, but perhaps it's the musk that gives that "feeling". It would be a PERFECT companion to a fireplace going, or to a gas or electric log "fake" fireplace. Since it was burning in the kitchen and I'd been in the family room, the scent wafted to me in a very nice way, but I was unaware of any crackling that may have been going on. I don't care about crackling. To me, the presentation and most importantly, the scent is all important. It burned quite evenly for several hours and the wax is even upon cooling. It doesn't appear as if much was used. I am so impressed and loving this scent, I purchased 2 more at the Prime Day price. When summer ends, it'll be the PERFECT fall/winter candle, however, personally, it's so lovely, it could be used year round. WONDERFUL, elevated, rich, homey scent!

    So I settled for the WoodWick Hourglass in Fireside - sure enough, I didn’t settle for less! If you’ve ever just melted and caramelized sugar in a sauce pan - that’s what this particular candle smells like! Just has a touch of sweet, woodsy scent along with it. Love how the lid of the candle doubles as a base to protect your surfaces!

    When you light it for the first time, the flame will appear offset but just give it a chance to do its job. The flame engulfs the wood wick and immediately starts crackling - just like a fireplace on a small scale! The flame is bright enough to light up a small room for a romantic or soothing environment. Very therapeutic.

    Like any candle, you have to maintain them. Make sure to carefully read the label on the bottom of the jar before you light it so you know what to do. Please don’t flip it while it’s lit and be careful when blowing it out as the wax on these candles are much less viscous than other candles. I don’t recommend using this candle for longer than 3 1/2 to 4 hours cause the wax liquefies quickly on the second or third use.

    This candle is totally worth every bit of the $18 I paid for it and I look forward to buying my next one from here! Shipped quickly, got here the next day.

About this Item

  • Sophisticated Fireside Fragrance: An iconic blend of bergamot, amber, exotic woods, and musk
  • Patented Pluswick Innovation: Delivers a distinctive crackling sound
  • Quality Wax Blend: Made with a premium mix of paraffin and soy wax for a clean, even burn
  • Distinctive Hourglass Design: Adds an elegant touch to your decor
  • Long Lasting: Provides a continuous rich, nuanced scent
  • Made in the USA: Manufactured with high quality domestic materials
  • Perfect Gift Item: Ideal for by yourself or for a friend

Product Description

Immerse yourself in the ambiance of a warm fire with the iconic Fireside fragrance from WoodWick. This large Hourglass candle, crafted in the USA, combines the finest ingredients including notes of bergamot, amber, exotic woods, and musk to create a sophisticated, complex scent. The patented Pluswick Innovation wick offers a unique sensory experience with its distinctive crackling sound and intriguing glow. The blend of paraffin and soy wax ensures an even, clean burn, filling your home with a rich, nuanced aroma. This high-quality candle also makes a coveted gift for a friend or loved one.
